ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Restored LAN diagram from EyeAuras.Wiki ru/triggers/network-message.md. Fixed one XML attribute quote and recovered the embedded router PNG from the author EN copy (commit 0024727b890706395ce08e29e43e251d2093538d, 2024-05-14). Labels use black on white for contrast. Original nodes, positions and arrow directions retained, including the lower hollow arrowhead. This is a repaired derivative, not byte-exact original source.
